name: Full Sail
rootCause: An attacker exploited a vulnerability in Switchboard’s production code to add a controlled key to a live oracle, published false prices roughly 100 times below market, deposited into Full Sail vaults at distorted values, then restored prices and withdrew more than deposited.

descriptions.text: An attacker exploited a vulnerability in Switchboard’s production code to add a controlled key to a live oracle, published false prices roughly 100 times below market, deposited into Full Sail vaults at distorted values, then restored prices and withdrew more than deposited.

Full Sail, a DeFi DEX and vault protocol on Sui, confirmed user fund losses on August 29, 2026, after a suspected Switchboard oracle compromise. The exact loss amount and technical attack details remain unconfirmed. Losses arose from Full Sail's reliance on compromised Switchboard oracle price feeds. The detailed vector,such as key compromise, implementation flaw, or misconfiguration,has not been published.
